sloka: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा बुधस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः ।वासाय विदधे बुद्धिं यदुक्तं ब्रह्मवादिना ।। ७.८९.२१ ॥
transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṁ śrutvā budhasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ ।vāsāya vidadhe buddhiṁ yaduktaṁ brahmavādinā ।। 7.89.21 ॥

translations.english: Having heard that word from Budha, whose deeds were untiring and who spoke of Brahman, Ila resolved in his mind to dwell there as instructed.
